title: DynamicMCPBench: A Trace-Grounded, Effect-Scored Benchmark for LLM Agents over Live MCP Servers
abstract: arXiv:2607.20531v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed over Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, yet the benchmarks used to evaluate them score the final answer or a fixed "ground-truth" list of tools, both of which are fragile once the underlying data is live and stateful. We present DynamicMCPBench, a reusable framework rather than a fixed dataset. A practitioner can run it on their own MCP servers to test models on their own tasks, or let it collect servers automatically to measure a model's general ability to solve agentic tasks. Given the servers and any set of models, it generates realistic goals, pursues each one live to record a successful trajectory, distills that trajectory into path-agnostic effect checkpoints, and scores an agent on whether it reproduces those effects, never on the final answer. To show what the framework reveals, we run it at scale: 24 models over 121 servers and 750 tasks spread evenly over 15 tas

translated_title: DynamicMCPBench：一个基于轨迹、按效果评分、面向实时MCP服务器的大语言模型智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地部署在模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器之上，然而目前用于评估它们的基准测试要么对最终答案打分，要么对固定的“真实”工具列表打分，一旦底层数据是实时且有状态的，这两种方式都变得脆弱。我们提出了DynamicMCPBench，这是一个可复用的框架而非固定数据集。实践者可以在自己的MCP服务器上运行它，用自己的任务来测试模型，也可以让它自动收集服务器，以衡量模型解决智能体任务的通用能力。给定服务器和任意一组模型，该框架会生成真实的目标，实时执行每个目标以记录成功轨迹，将该轨迹提炼为与路径无关的效果检查点，并根据智能体是否重现这些效果来评分，而不是根据最终答案。为了展示该框架能够揭示的内容，我们进行了大规模运行：24个模型、121个服务器、750个任务，均匀分布在15个任务类别上。
tldr: DynamicMCPBench是一个可复用的动态基准框架，通过将实时执行MCP服务器任务的成功轨迹提炼为与路径无关的效果检查点来评估LLM智能体，摆脱了传统基于最终答案或固定工具列表的脆弱评分方式。
en_tdlr: DynamicMCPBench is a reusable, trace-grounded benchmark that evaluates LLM agents on live MCP servers by distilling successful trajectories into path-agnostic effect checkpoints, scoring agents on whether they reproduce those effects rather than on final answers or fixed tool lists.
